name: CopperDew: Atmospheric Coil Water Harvester
tag: Simulates, plans and monitors a copper-coil system that condenses water from humid air.

scenarios.title: Estimate daily water
scenarios.ask: How much water can {coil} of copper coil pull at {rh} humidity with {cool}?
steps: At {rh} humidity, the coil must stay below the dew point for water to form.
With {cool}, the coil stays below dew point for about {=min(24, 4 + cool * 3)} hours a day.
Sized a drip tray and a {=ceil(coil * 0.02 * (rh - 25) / 50 * cool * 3 + 5)}-liter food-grade tank.
followups: Why so little water in dry air?
Below about 30% humidity, the dew point is so low the coil rarely reaches it. The simulator shows this so you don't overbuild.
Is the water safe to drink?
Condensed water still needs a filter and a test, and copper can dissolve into water that sits in the coil. The app includes a treatment step and test reminders.

scenarios.title: Plan the build
scenarios.ask: Build a {coil} coil from {tube} copper tube. Give me a parts list.
steps: Laid out a spiral of {coil} with fins to add surface area.
Estimated {=round(coil * tube, 1)} kg of copper tube.
Added fittings, a drip tray, food-grade tubing, a pre-filter and a tank.
Wrote {=6 + ceil(coil / 10)} build steps with photos.
followups: Copper moves heat quickly, so the coil cools evenly. The trade-off is cost and the need to treat the water.
Can I use a different metal?
Yes. Aluminum or stainless options are in the simulator so you can compare yield and cost.

scenarios.title: Monitor several units
scenarios.ask: We run {units} units. Alert us when yield drops more than {drop}.
steps: Connected humidity, coil temperature and tank level sensors on {units} unit(s).
Learned each unit's normal yield for its weather over 7 days.
Flags any unit whose yield drops {drop} below what the weather predicts.
Sends a weekly summary of water collected per unit.
followups: Dust on the coil, a blocked drip line, or a cooling fault. The alert says which sensor changed first.
No. Units can report over a low-power radio link to one gateway.
